Reset: Pulse: clear all particles and restart the system.
Count: Maximum number of live particles. Keep it at or above Emitrate x Lifetime.
Emitrate: Particles born per second, spread over the input points.
Emitvelocity: Initial upward velocity of new particles in world units per second.
Speed: Time-scale multiplier for the simulation. 1 = normal.
Seed: Random seed for emission and noise.
Curlstrength: Strength of the curl-noise swirling force. 0 = none.
Curlscale: Spatial scale of the curl noise. Larger = bigger swirls.
Curlspeed: How fast the curl noise field evolves.
Gravity: Downward acceleration in world units per second squared.
Damping: Velocity damping. 0 = none; higher slows particles faster.
Attrradius: Radius in world units within which the attractors act.
Attr1strength: Pull of attractor 1. Negative values repel; 0 = off.
Attr2strength: Pull of attractor 2. Negative values repel; 0 = off.
Color: Colour of particles at birth, written to the Color attribute.
Colorend: Colour of particles at the end of their life.
Pointsize: Preview only: point size in pixels.
Brightness: Preview only: brightness of the points.
Camdist: Preview only: camera distance in world units.
